title: It’s good but
text: This is very good and got me into PixelArt. My only complain is that there is no way to move certain parts of your picture. If there is a thing that you want moved somewhere else, you have to erase it completely and recreate it somewhere else. It doesn’t sound like a big deal but it would make a lot of my art much better, and a lot of other drawing apps have a feature like that. I just wish they added a mode that lets you color over certain parts of your art, and then lets you move around those parts that you colored.

title: Camera Handling on phones
text:
The camera handling is very frustrating (IDK how it is on tablets). I’m trying to move my image to color another part and it’s extremely aggravating. I have to use 2 fingers and even then it’s unreasonably hard.

Fix 1: Zoom into and out based off where my fingers are located on the screen. It’ll zoom me into the center of the image or bring me out to the corner for whatever reason. If I zoom on the top left corner zoom me on the top left corner.

Fix 2 remove the auto-fill boxes from single finger sliding. Making it one click away and removed on release of single finger slides. So I can scroll with one finger because sliding/scrolling with 2 fingers gave me a headache.

The app is good but it definitely needs QOL changes.

title: Great app but needs better equipment
text:
I love this app and it definitely stands outs from the crowd with its great compatibility. But there are a few things you guys need to add and here's them.

1: you should have the ability to have more color in one picture 

2: you should have more tools to work with ex. eye dropper, eraser, paint bucket, different opacity, rewind tool

3: you should add better cropping instead of it just having a square you should have one the size of an iPhone or iPad or smaller we should be able to control that

4: we should have different layers to work with. We should be able to color on the inside without worrying on the outline or work on the shadows with out worrying on the main colors
